input: Build a simple floating shelf for the entryway

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Knowing the intended dimensions (length, depth, thickness) determines the amount of material needed and the structural approach.
Understanding whether this is a solo build or involves helpers, or whether the user is a beginner or experienced, shapes how detailed and step-by-step the plan needs to be.
The wall type (drywall with studs, concrete, brick, plaster) completely changes the mounting hardware and installation method.
A defined budget determines whether to buy pre-made materials, reclaim wood, or use premium lumber and hardware.
The desired visual style (rustic, modern, minimalist) and finish (paint, stain, natural) drives material choice and surface treatment.
Knowing what the shelf will hold (keys/mail, plants, heavy books, decorative items) determines the required load capacity and bracket strength.
Knowing which tools the user already owns (drill, level, saw, sander) determines whether any tools need to be borrowed, rented, or whether the plan should avoid certain steps entirely.

gold.taskTitle: Build a floating shelf for the entryway
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to design and build a simple floating shelf to be mounted in their entryway.

questions.title: What length and depth do you want the shelf to be?
questions.description: Clarifies the physical dimensions of the shelf, which drives material quantities and structural requirements.

questions.title: How experienced are you with DIY woodworking projects?
questions.description: Determines how detailed and beginner-friendly the instructions need to be.

questions.title: What type of wall will you be mounting it on?
questions.description: Wall type (drywall/studs, concrete, brick, plaster) dictates the correct anchors and mounting method.

questions.title: What is your budget for materials and hardware?
questions.description: Defines whether to use premium, standard, or reclaimed materials and which mounting hardware is viable.

questions.title: What finish or style should the shelf match in your entryway?
questions.description: Guides wood species selection, surface treatment, and overall aesthetic direction.

questions.title: What items will the shelf primarily hold or display?
questions.description: Determines the required load-bearing capacity and informs bracket size and spacing.

questions.title: Which tools do you already have available at home?
questions.description: Reveals whether any tools need to be sourced and allows the plan to be tailored to available equipment.
